Functional examples illustrate triggers; solutions are proposals; note tradeoffs need representative Unreal runtime measurement
Preserve caches, in-flight deduplication, batching, bounded walks, watcher debounce, read cancellation and authenticated LFS recovery; avoid retry storms
Undo retains its separate category and stable IDs; mutation gate LG-009 also covers Undo
Functional completion requires implemented and verified behavior; regeneration preserves checkbox state
UI audit baseline uses current source and isolated selection functions; no live screenshots, screen reader or measured contrast proof
UI Source means inspected implementation; Suggestion means proposed improvement; isolated selection reproduction is not end-to-end UI proof
UI navigation/menus/filtering reuse loaded data; fetch history/blob/comparison only on request; preserve bounded work and caching
Lock selection uses visible order and captured anchor; additive owner checkboxes are explicit; right-click targets deliberate selection; force-unlock lists owners/paths
UI acceptance must pass before checking; partial work remains unchecked; shared consumers verified; LG/UI completion tracked independently
